newsitem.title: USA: Dow gains more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow gains more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average gained more than 50 points in less than 10 minutes of wall Street's opening on Friday.
The 30 blue-chip issues were up 50.43 points at 7,704.68, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
